scope: Native1024 unedited originals inspected for indices000 and001 only; no attractiveness ratings.

images.observation: Dense fine grain across face and background; strongly red/dark face, blackened eye and hair areas. Apparent child in casual clothing; not a target priest portrait.
Dense woven-looking fine grain across skin, head covering and background; strong pink/red cast. Adult-looking face with head covering and patterned clothing, not a target portrait.
Most dense fine grain disappears while identity and framing remain. Red/magenta tone, excessive contrast, black eye/hair areas and contour-like texture remain.
Large reduction of image-wide grain reveals coherent face geometry, but pink cast and etched/painted texture at forehead, hair, clothing and background persist.
Fine grain largely removed but tone and contrast still unnatural; small hair/skin texture changes relative to single reset. Not restored to photographic baseline.
Similarly large reduction of original dense grain, but skin becomes somewhat more mottled/textured than single reset; pink cast, etched contours and head covering remain.

interpretation: For these two fixed latents at this checkpoint, intervention on the single highest-resolution noise offset removes much fine grain. It does not explain all residual tone/contrast/texture defects, demonstrate successful priest conversion, or predict outcome of training with frozen noise.
